text:
Type: ombré wool area rug
Use: softening a floor by a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: wool, fine flat-woven striated texture
Colors: charcoal, taupe, light warm grey
Shape: rectangular, gradient fading from light to dark in soft horizontal bands, clean edges, medium size
Feel: calm, subtle, grounded
Goes with: light wood floors, teal or grey walls, black accents; minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ombré Wool Rug, 4' x 6', Charcoal
product.description: Pile: 100% Wool, Backing: 100% Canvas Imported Deep and light hues fade into each other in this ombré pattern rug. Subtle yet striking, this 100% wool rug is high on style and softness. Area rug features an ombré pattern Hand-tufted with 100% wool fibers Plush .65'' pile suits high-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 4' x 6' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
